title: Flukin Font
author: Typia Nesia
description:
Flukin – Bubble Balloon Graffiti Font – Playful Bold Street Urban Logo Font
Flukin is a modern bubble balloon graffiti font that blends playful street energy with bold urban style. Inspired by graffiti culture and cartoon aesthetics, this typeface features rounded balloon-like shapes and organic curves that create a fun, expressive, and eye-catching look. Designed with a playful urban character, Flukin brings a vibrant Y2K vibe combined with contemporary street design, making it perfect for logo design, streetwear graphics, music artwork, posters, packaging, branding, cafés, urban-themed visuals, and any project that needs a lively, friendly, and visually impactful presence.
Add playful urban energy to your designs with Flukin. Download now and make your typography pop.
